svg.desc: 80 models; for each, the best official, lab-claimed and independent pass@1 at any effort level.
svg.text: Best DeepSWE 1.1 score per model, by who measured it
The rule spans the gap between sources for the same model. Colour is the lab; shape is who measured it.
